faqs.a:
This article shall govern the appointment, suspension, compensation, and management
               including discipline of judges in the municipal court in accordance with section 8.2
               of the Charter. Each municipal judge shall be appointed by the city council and notwithstanding
               anything in any subsequent section of this chapter to the contrary, serve at the pleasure
               of the city council.
(Code 1981, § 18-40; Ord. No. 3676, § 1, 1-22-2001)
